newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee council to hold talks June 23.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee council to hold talks June 23.

text.p: Members of Brazil's coffee council, known as the CDPC, will meet in Sao Paulo June 23 at 1400 local/1700 GMT, said council member and grower representative Manoel Bertone.
The meeting will be to hold preliminary talks ahead of the next full session of the council, scheduled for the beginning of July in Santos, Bertone added.
The CDPC is a joint government/private sector body, presided over by Industry and Commerce Minister Francisco Dornelles.

Issues being tackled by the council are producer financing and problems facing the country's soluble coffee industry which claims it is losing out to other producers who are able to buy raw materials more cheaply on the international market.
